description: Experience sampling, 4 prompts a day (9am, 1pm, 5pm, 9pm) for 14 days, community sample of 40 French-speaking adults: five items on key features of rumination since the previous prompt (perseverance, negativity, self-criticism, brooding, replaying). 0-100 sliders.
reference: Hoebeke, Y., Blanchard, M. A., Contreras, A., & Heeren, A. (2022). An experience sampling measure of the key features of rumination. Clinical Neuropsychiatry, 19(5), 288-297.
notes: Processed from the openESM harmonised copy (0013_hoebeke, 10.5281/zenodo.22952951); original deposit https://osf.io/dngyk/, also CC BY 4.0. See data/hoebeke_2022_rumination_esm.py.
